project.title: Yared: The Voice of Ethiopian Heritage
project.subject: Saint Yared and Ethiopian sacred musical heritage

style.description: Traditional Ethiopian religious painting and illuminated manuscript inspiration, rich gold, deep blue, red and earth tones, decorative borders, respectful historical artistic interpretation.
style.consistency: Keep the same artistic style, color palette and character design throughout all scenes.

shots.visual_prompt: Ethiopian highlands at sunrise, traditional Ethiopian painted landscape, golden light, decorative manuscript border.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera movement toward the sunrise.
shots.narration_am: በኢትዮጵያ ታሪክ ውስጥ ሙዚቃ ከዜማ በላይ ትርጉም አለው።
shots.subtitle_en: In Ethiopian history, music means more than melody.

shots.visual_prompt: Ancient Ethiopian parchment manuscript with Ge'ez writing, gold decorations and warm candlelight.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera movement across the manuscript.
shots.subtitle_en: It expresses faith, culture, and identity.

shots.visual_prompt: Respectful traditional Ethiopian painted artistic interpretation of Saint Yared in historic church clothing, not a verified portrait.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle movement toward the central figure.
shots.narration_am: በዚህ ታሪክ ውስጥ የቅዱስ ያሬድ ስም በክብር ይጠራል።
shots.subtitle_en: The name of Saint Yared is remembered with respect.

shots.visual_prompt: Traditional Ethiopian church singers wearing white robes, painted in Ethiopian icon-inspired style.
shots.narration_am: በኢትዮጵያ ባህላዊ ትውፊት መሠረት፣ ያሬድ በቤተ ክርስቲያን የዜማ ታሪክ ውስጥ ታላቅ አስተዋጽኦ ያበረከተ ሰው ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: According to Ethiopian tradition, Yared made a great contribution to church music.

shots.visual_prompt: Ethiopian sacred music manuscripts, Ge'ez writing and traditional musical symbols, painted parchment aesthetic.
shots.narration_am: የእርሱ ስም ከቅዱስ ዜማና ከመንፈሳዊ ትምህርት ጋር ይያያዛል።
shots.subtitle_en: His name is connected with sacred song and spiritual teaching.

shots.visual_prompt: Traditional Ethiopian church choir singing together, rich blue and gold painted composition.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle movement as singers perform together.
shots.narration_am: ይህ ባህል ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ ይተላለፋል።
shots.subtitle_en: This tradition is passed from one generation to another.

shots.visual_prompt: An experienced Ethiopian church music teacher teaching younger students, traditional painted artwork.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow movement toward the students learning.
shots.narration_am: ዛሬም ይህ የሙዚቃ ቅርስ በዜማዎች፣ በጸሎትና በትምህርት ይኖራል።
shots.subtitle_en: Even today, this musical heritage lives through song, prayer, and teaching.

shots.visual_prompt: Beautiful Ethiopian church and landscape at sunset, traditional painting style, space for film title.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pull back and gentle fade to the title.
shots.narration_am: ያሬድ የታሪክ ስም ብቻ አይደለም፤ የማንነታችን ድምፅ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: Yared is not only a name from history; he is a voice of our heritage.
